mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Thought Distortion
# 1. "This spell can't be countered." is the compiler's (B14), compiled[0].
# 2. "Target opponent reveals their hand." is the compiler's REVEAL (B5b-reveal-hand), kept.
# 3. "Exile all noncreature, nonland cards from that player's hand and graveyard.": the "exile all
#    <cards> from <zone>" MOVE_ZONE of Tormod's Crypt / Idol of Endurance (role 'target', mode ALL,
#    Zone(EXILE, OWNER)), over the target player's hand and graveyard; "that player" after "Target
#    opponent reveals their hand" reads TARGET_PLAYER (Duress; query.player_target_slot: one
#    designated player, opponent-only because the tree reads TARGET_OPPONENT). "noncreature,
#    nonland card" is Duress's FAnd of two FNot(TYPE_EQ).
reveal = compiled[1].effect
spell = SpellAbility(
    kind=SpellKind.SORCERY,
    effect=Seq(
        steps=(
            reveal,
            A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
                'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.EXILE, controller=ControllerRef.OWNER),
                'target': Selector(
                    count=QUnbounded(),
                    mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
                    filter=FAnd(
                        children=(
                            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature')),
                            FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Land')),
                        ),
                    ),
                    zones=(
                        Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.TARGET_PLAYER),
                        Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.TARGET_PLAYER),
                    ),
                ),
            }),
        ),
    ),
)
abilities = [compiled[0], spell]

clauses.clause: Exile all noncreature, nonland cards from that player's hand and graveyard.

g0_warnings: component shapes no compiled card has (review them in the probe): selector ALL [GRAVEYARD,HAND]
mapping.notes: Can't-be-countered static and the REVEAL are the compiler's. Exile: Tormod's Crypt / Idol of Endurance 'exile all <cards> from <zone>' MOVE_ZONE (role target, mode ALL, Zone(EXILE, OWNER)) over Zone(HAND|GRAVEYARD, TARGET_PLAYER); 'that player' after 'Target opponent reveals their hand' reads TARGET_PLAYER as in Duress (one designated player, opponent-only, query.player_target_slot); 'noncreature, nonland' is Duress's FAnd of FNot(TYPE_EQ). G0 warns ALL over [GRAVEYARD,HAND] is a new selector shape: the probe exiles opp_trick (hand) and opp_used (graveyard) and leaves the creature cards.
